The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Rayc Ryjerd]] purchased a '''starship'''<ref name="card" /> sometime before or during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="date">Rayc Ryjerd's [http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/JabbasPalace-Light/large/raycryjerd.gif card] pictures him during [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], which is set in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.</ref> putting [[Gender/Legends|himself]] into debt in the process. He worked for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] in an effort to pay these debts.<ref name="card" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Starship/Legends|starship]] was briefly mentioned on the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] card for Rayc Ryjerd in the [[1998]] ''[[Jabba's Palace Limited]]'' expansion.<ref name="card" />
